Configure current feature

  1. Create an original diagnostic 32x64 transparent avatar texture, its bottom-center sprite and masked material using their individual pages; do not invent a paid sheet layout.
  2. Create AS_Common before ABP_Common and its current-phase sequences. Bind each to the corresponding diagnostic flipbook after installed PaperZD factory inspection. Stop the PaperZD portion if no compatible plugin is available; physics may use a clearly labeled Paper2D debug fallback.
  3. Add the one URPGCameraComponent and URPGPaperDollComponent to the current character; assign DA_Camera_Default/DA_AnimationSet_Common. Set fixed azimuth45/elevation50 and perspective35-degree FOV as proposals, zoom900–1600cm.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Open L_ArtLab and position the body at floor, ramp, upper bridge and lower walkway markers in turn.
  2. Resolve Idle/Walk for North/East/South/West via a development presentation selector; observe body/overlay foot markers and ordering at near/far zoom.
  3. Move camera-follow target behind the occlusion wall. Zoom to both clamps; attempt rotate input, which is intentionally unmapped.
Expected success
Foot pivot follows 3D floor elevation without changing capsule height; no camera rotation is available.
Masked sprite ordering is stable across bridge levels; an absent overlay leaves the body visible. Exact paid-body compatibility remains unverified.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. No claim that the actual archive has diagonal/swim/cast/mount art. Orthographic is a measured fallback, not the default.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. Before networking, verify local cleanup but do not label it a multiplayer test.

Stop condition and deferred work

Local capsule and layered sprite remain aligned through four facings; art source gap stays explicit.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
